exit0_meaning: Complete CPU evidence analysis only; not a performance/quality acceptance
scope: Current canonical-contract ActQuant-ON A16 layer0 Qcur-0 S/QB/Q4; no new kernel selection

ActQuant_operator.code_scope: Recovered from exported F32 output and official scale; internal integer register not observed

isolated_operator.metric: (GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime)*1e6 after completion; GPU command-buffer elapsed microseconds
isolated_operator.scope: One Qcur-0 matvec dispatch on actual physical-phone post-ActQuant step16 W/X; quantizer preparation excluded

additional_isolated_operator_cohorts.scope: Post-main isolated repeat; separate thermal/power cohort, no Fair/Serious pooling

formal_wall_observation.interpretation: Six positive per-round Q4-minus-stock wall medians establish no speedup in the collected campaign; no cross-cohort pooling, general thermal claim or pure-shader attribution.

interpretation_boundaries: Formal wall and isolated GPU command-buffer elapsed are separate scopes.
Different thermal/power states are not pooled; transition/unknown pairs retain counts only.
CPU regions are nested worker elapsed including waits/preemption; they are not additive CPU cycles or model critical-path time.
Snapshot/key work runs under the shared library lock; only selected-Q lock waits were measured, not global selector contention or pure realpath cost.
Matching thermal-state endpoints are coarse observations, not proof of continuously fixed temperature/frequency.
CB GPU/host clocks are separate; no pure per-shader cost or hardware bottleneck inferred.
All local, stock-relative and isolated checks leave the prior official-model strict failure unchanged.
